description: Synthetic, adversarial-free operator-voice fixture corpora for M2 calibration (build plan D2 / §13 M2.7). NOT real operator text: every document is hand-authored synthetic prose written to exhibit a known, deterministic style so calibration outputs are reproducible. `label` records the intended ground truth: `stable` corpora are internally consistent (low variance -> should calibrate to SUPPORTED under the preregistered manifest); `noisy` corpora vary wildly (high variance -> must remain OBSERVED). `operator` corpora feed the operator profile; the `external` corpus exists only to prove EXTERNAL text is calibration-excluded.
